title: Departmental Load Balancing
scenario: Find the projects where the number of employees is higher than the company-wide average per project. Return 'project_id'.
tableSchema: projects (project_id INT, start_date DATE, end_date DATE, budget INT), employees (employee_id INT, project_id INT, role VARCHAR, salary INT)
hint: Calculate count per project, then compare with AVG(count).
correctQuery: SELECT project_id FROM employees GROUP BY project_id HAVING COUNT(employee_id) > (SELECT COUNT(employee_id)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT project_id) FROM employees);
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE employees (employee_id INT, project_id INT, role VARCHAR, salary INT); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (101, 1, 'Dev', 100), (102, 1, 'Dev', 100), (103, 2, 'Dev', 100);
